diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service can attach this project before its Compute Engine API is enabled. Unlike shared_vpc_host, it has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. Add depends_on so attachment waits for API enablement when compute.googleapis.com is managed in var.services.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion uses the Cloud Logging API but can run concurrently with google_project_service.project_services. When logging.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, exclusion creation must wait for that enablement; add depends_on, as already done for the logging sinks.
